key_insight: Func-R1 addresses multimodal math reasoning by reducing visual-text interference in function problems through a decoupled architecture that jointly strengthens perception and theory.
engineering_relevance: The paper is relevant for building MLLMs that must read plots, diagrams, and function visuals reliably, improving robustness in scientific and engineering reasoning tasks.
method: Explicitly decoupled architecture separates visual perception from logical reasoning.
Hierarchical post-training first identifies critical visual evidence, then performs deeper theoretical reasoning.
PATO steers updates toward theoretical consistency while correcting heterogeneous visual information during reasoning.
evidence_signal: The method was evaluated across diverse benchmarks and is reported to be the best among open-source MLLMs, with an 8.4% gain over GPT-5 on MathVerse function-oriented tasks.
watch_item: Because the approach relies on staged post-training and careful visual evidence alignment, performance may depend on high-quality function-related visual supervision and robust benchmark transfer.
paper_title: Func-R1: Incentivizing Mathematical Function Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
